newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat futures rally on short covering - traders.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat futures rally on short covering - traders.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures rallied sharply early Wednesday on short covering by commercial firms, floor traders said.
"The commercials are a little nervous about going into the (USDA) report short," said one floor trader.
Cargill bought 2.5 million bushels July on the open, and Continental Grain bought 500,000 bushels of July in early trade, pit sources said.
At 1003, wheat was up five to seven cents per bushel, with May up seven cents at $3.96-1/2 per bushel and July up five cents at $3.90-1/2 cents.
